name: ASML Holding NV
rationale: Enter: rank 2 of 42 by 12-1 momentum (+61.4%); trend ON (IE00B4L5Y983 130.52 > SMA200 120.6632); target weight 25% of NAV 1000.00 EUR.
thesis: v001 buys the second-strongest 12-1 momentum instrument while the MSCI World is in an uptrend. ASML is up 61% over the twelve months to a month ago; on 14 October it reported Q3 revenue of about EUR 11.7bn and raised 2026 guidance to EUR 44-45bn, and management expects capacity bottlenecks in 2027-2028. Caveat: it overlaps heavily with order 2026-10-19-01 (ASML is a top holding of the semiconductor ETF), so together the two are close to one 48% bet on semiconductors. What proves it wrong under the rules: momentum turning negative or rank worse than 7 at a monthly exit window, or the MSCI World closing more than 3% below its 200-day average. Outside the rules: order cancellations or a guidance cut, or the valuation concern (Jefferies Hold, target EUR 1,650, about 11% above the last price) winning out over earnings growth. At EUR 240 and a price near EUR 1,489 this is a fractional order of about 0.16 shares; if the broker refuses fractional one-off stock orders, the preview will say so.
